title: 第5章 发工资聚人心，反手清算张家父子-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》
content:
第(1/3)页

    清晨六点半。

    天刚蒙蒙亮，林川已经把那辆黑色奥迪A6停在了江城第三机械厂锈迹斑斑的大门口。

    厂子不大，但是占地足足有30亩。

    两栋灰扑扑的车间厂房，一排破旧的办公平房，

    院子里杂草从水泥裂缝里疯长出来，半人多高。

    “爸，今天你就在旁边坐着。”林川推开车门，

    “该说什么、该做什么，我来。”

    林建国张了张嘴，最终只是重重地点了一下头。

    上午八点。

    厂办公室前面那块长满青苔的水泥坝子上，稀稀拉拉地站了三十来号人。

    都是厂里的老工人。

    接到通知说今天来厂里开会、结算工资，大多数人脸上写满了不信。

    这年头，哪个厂子倒闭了不是拖到最后一分钱都拿不到？

    林家自己都被银行逼得差点扫地出门，拿什么发工资？

    但是死马当活马医。万一呢？

    林川提着那个黑色密码皮箱，大步从厂门口走过来。

    身后跟着林建国。

    工人们的目光齐刷刷地落在那个皮箱上，

    又抬头看了看停在厂门口那辆黑得发亮的奥迪A6，交头接耳的声音瞬间大了几分。

    林川把皮箱放在办公室门口那张落满灰的铁桌子上，目光扫过在场所有人。

    没有寒暄，没有客套。

    “我是林川，林建国的儿子。今天叫大家来，就一件事。”

    他伸手，“吧嗒”一声打开密码箱。

    箱盖掀起的瞬间，初夏清晨的阳光正好从厂房的缝隙里斜射过来，照在那一摞摞码得整整齐齐的百元大钞上。

    红光刺目。

    坝子上瞬间没了声音。

    三十多双眼睛死死地钉在那个箱子上，有人下意识地往前迈了半步，又像被烫到一样缩了回去。

    “厂里欠大家的工资，我这里有完整的账目。

    ”林川的声音不大，但每个字都砸得清清楚楚，

    “今天，一分不少，现场结清。”

    沉默。

    长达七八秒的沉默。

    然后，人群最后面一个穿着油渍斑斑工装的瘦老头突然开了口，

    声音带着股不敢相信的颤：“林……林家小子，你说的是真的？不是又画饼哄我们？”

    “王叔。”林川笑着看着他，“我什么时候跟你画过饼？”

    说完，他从箱子里拿出第一摞钞票，抽掉捆扎的纸带，开始一张一张地数。

    “车间主任老赵，欠薪四个月，一共五千二。”

    林川数出五千二百块，“啪”地一声拍在桌上。

    老赵愣了三秒，腿一软，差点没站稳。

    他颤着手把钱拿过去，翻来覆去地数了两遍，鼻子一酸，眼眶当场就红了。

    “钳工组李大兵，欠薪五个月零十三天，六千九百块。”

    啪。

    “焊工刘胖子，欠薪两个月两千四。”

    啪。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It’s half past six in the morning.

It was just dawn, and Lin Chuan had parked the black Audi A6 at the rusty gate of Jiangcheng No. 3 Machinery Factory.

The factory is not big, but it covers an area of ​​30 acres.

Two dusty workshop buildings and a row of dilapidated office bungalows,

In the yard, weeds grew wildly from the cement cracks, reaching half a person's height.

"Dad, you are sitting next to me today." Lin Chuan opened the car door.

"I will do what you say and do."

Lin Jianguo opened his mouth, but in the end he just nodded heavily.

Eight o'clock in the morning.

On the moss-covered cement dam in front of the factory office, about thirty people stood sparsely.

They are all old workers in the factory.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ out out was made was that they were coming to the factory for a meeting today to settle wages. Most people had disbelief written all over their faces.

"These days, which factory goes bankrupt and doesn't get even the last penny?"

The Lin family themselves were almost forced out of their homes by the bank, so what salary would they get?

​​But treating a dead horse as a live doctor.What if?

Lin Chuan strode from the factory gate carrying the black password suitcase.

Lin Jianguo was followed behind him.

The workers’ eyes all fell on the suitcase.

He looked up again at the shiny black Audi A6 parked at the entrance of the factory, and the whispers suddenly became louder.

Lin Chuan put the suitcase on the dusty iron table at the door of the office and glanced at everyone present.

No small talk, no courtesy.

"I am Lin Chuan, the son of Lin Jianguo. I am calling everyone here for one thing."

He stretched out his hand and opened the lockbox with a click.

The moment the lid of the box was lifted, the early morning sunlight in early summer slanted through the cracks in the factory building, shining on the neatly numbered stacks of hundred-dollar bills.

The red light is dazzling.

There was no sound in the dam for an instant.

More than thirty pairs of eyes were fixed on the box. Some people subconsciously took half a step forward and then retracted as if they had been burned.

“The factory owes everyone wages, and I have complete accounts here.

" Lin Chuan's voice was not loud, but every word was spelled clearly.

"Today, every penny is a penny and it will be settled on the spot."

Silence.

There was silence for seven or eight seconds.

Then, a thin old man wearing oil-stained overalls at the back of the crowd suddenly spoke,

His voice trembled with disbelief: "Lin... boy from the Lin family, are you telling the truth? Aren't you trying to trick us again?"

"Uncle Wang." Lin Chuan looked at him with a smile, "When did I draw a cake with you?"

After saying that, he took out the first pile of banknotes from the box, took off the paper tape, and started counting them one by one.

"Old Zhao, the workshop director, owes four months' salary, a total of five thousand two thousand."

Lin Chuan counted out five thousand two hundred yuan and slapped it on the table with a "snap".

​​Old Zhao was stunned for three seconds, his legs went weak, and he almost lost his balance.

He took the money with trembling hands and counted it over and over again. His nose felt sore and his eyes turned red on the spot.

"Li Dabing of the fitter group is owed five months and thirteen days' salary, worth 6,900 yuan."



"Fatty Liu, the welder, is owed two months' wages of NT$2,400."

title_en: Chapter 5: Paying wages to gather people's hearts, backhand to liquidate the Zhang family and his son - "Rebirth 2000: I broke the agreement and became rich"
